report.title: Water Connection, July 2025 - Consumer Confidence Report (2025 Report to Consumers on Water Quality)

sources_described: Morgan Hill is in South Santa Clara County between the Coyote and Llagas underground aquifers, which are the source of its water supply. The City has 16 active groundwater wells that supplied 2.33 billion gallons in 2025 to about 15,306 connections; the water is disinfected with sodium hypochlorite.

extraction_notes: Cover is titled 'July 2025' but the body is the '2025 Report to Consumers on Water Quality' covering January 1 - December 31, 2025 (published 2026), so data_year is 2025. Data tables span pages 6 (microbiological, lead/copper, school lead, sodium/hardness) and 7 (primary, disinfection byproducts/chlorine, SOC, secondary, additional constituents, PFAS); page assignment verified against rendered images because pdftotext bled page-7 text onto page 6. Single 'Groundwater range of detection' column (low/high/avg across wells), so source_group is null. The report prints 0 rather than ND for non-detects (arsenic, 1,2,3-TCP, turbidity, lead 90th percentile, and all range lows for TTHM/HAA5/barium/PFAS); zeros are copied as printed, with detected=false only where every printed figure is 0. Units copied verbatim: mg/L vs mg/l, ug/L vs µg/L, umho/cm, 'UNITS' for turbidity, 'unit' for pH, grains/gal (printed GRAINS/GAL). PFAS and lithium are 2024 samples reported in ug/L (pipeline must convert to ppt). 1,2,3-TCP MCL/PHG printed as 0 and the arsenic PHG printed as 5 are copied as printed. Nitrate is reported as N with MCL 10 (the 2024 edition used as-NO3 / 45). No violations: 'For the calendar year 2025, your tap water met all U.S. EPA and State drinking water health standards' and the system is 'in full compliance'; all 'Exceeded MCL?' cells read NO/NS. Text verified against rendered images of pages 6 and 7.
